summary: Frontend-only test of shared favourites hook (lib/favorites). Verified: Ricette Custodite showcase heart (custodite-fav-<id>) toggles without opening the recipe, turns red with aria-pressed=true, persists after reload; Custodite detail heart (custodite-fav-detail-<id>) synced both directions with the showcase card; MikiLab recipe detail heart (fav-recipe-<id>) syncs with the list card heart (recipe-fav-<id>) without reload; 'Favourites' chip (cat-filter-favs) filters correctly and its counter excludes 'custodite:' keys. All 4 requested scenarios PASS.
action_items: MINOR (optional): RecipeList.jsx (~line 445) empty-state uses favs.size === 0, which also counts 'custodite:' keys. If a user has only Custodite favourites, activating 'Preferite' shows the generic no-results text instead of the 'Nessuna preferita ancora...' hint. Use the same non-custodite predicate as the chip counter.
MINOR: multiple 401 responses appear in the browser console while browsing anonymously (before login) on Home/Ricette; auth-gated calls fire for guests.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/favorites.jsx is correct: single localStorage key + custom event, listeners cleaned up; namespacing custodite ids with the 'custodite:' prefix avoids collisions with recipe UUIDs.
Custodite heart is a sibling absolute button outside the card <button> (no nested-button issue) and the MikiLab card heart uses e.stopPropagation() - both correctly avoid opening the recipe.
seed_data_creation: none; favourited existing recipe 'Natural Pro Improver' and custodite 'matera' in localStorage only
test_credentials: admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (used for MikiLab recipe list/detail)
context_for_next_testing_agent: MikiLab recipe cards live inside collapsed accordions: click [data-testid^='cat-folder-'] first, otherwise recipe-row-<id>/recipe-fav-<id> are not in the DOM. Recipe detail is a Dialog - close with Escape. 'Le Ricette Custodite' via nav-tab-ricette -> ricette-vetrina opens the 'matera' detail directly; press custodite-back to reach custodite-list. Favourites stored in localStorage key 'mikilab_fav_recipes'.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a - no defects reproduced in the tested scope
